findings.title: Ignore camera-clipped surfaces during anchor raycasts
findings.requirement: Compute anchor visibility against the actual 3D scene during preparation.
findings.trigger: A camera with near=1, a fully clipped opaque blocker at camera depth 0.20-0.30, and an exposed hook target at depth 5.82.
findings.observed: Clipped-blocker and hidden-blocker PNG bytes have the same SHA-256, but the target sidecars report occluded and visible respectively. The clipped variant also removes the target protected region.
findings.impact: Native hide-occluded labels disappear and exposed proof regions lose protection even though the blocker is absent from the rendered plate.
findings.repair: Filter raycast intersections according to camera-space clipping before deciding occlusion.
findings.parentVerification: Independently rehashed both PNGs, read both sidecars and confirmed native overlay displayState depends on the erroneous visibility.

findings.title: Validate shot rig and part references before capture
findings.requirement: report missing dependencies, hash mismatches and unsupported inputs without rendering, modifying source or writing a package.
findings.trigger: An unknownSlider rig writer or unknownPart hidden-part reference on E01 final shot V8-09.
findings.observed: Both dependency inspection and CLI validate return success with no findings. Frame evaluation then throws Unknown rig writer or Unknown hidden part.
findings.impact: Preparation validates and captures shots sequentially; a fresh run can capture 603 earlier frames before discovering the invalid last-shot reference.
findings.repair: Check all shot control IDs and hidden-part IDs against the loaded scene during shared read-only inspection.
findings.parentVerification: Independently reran standalone deps/validate/evaluation controls on current source and checked final-shot start=603 and sequential prepare loop.
